+def _dependency_solver(preference, name_order):
+    def solve(data):
+        packages = data["packages"]
+        features = set(data.get("features", []))
+        blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+        pins = data.get("pins", {})
+        names = sorted(packages, reverse=(name_order == "descending"))
+        best = None
+        best_vector = None
+
+        def search(chosen, constraints, edges):
+            nonlocal best, best_vector
+            pending = [name for name in constraints if name not in chosen]
+            if not pending:
+                # Reject cycles in the selected dependency graph.
+                done, active = set(), set()
+
+                def visit(name):
+                    if name in active:
+                        return False
+                    if name in done:
+                        return True
+                    active.add(name)
+                    if any(not visit(child) for child in edges.get(name, [])):
+                        return False
+                    active.remove(name)
+                    done.add(name)
+                    return True
+
+                if not all(visit(name) for name in chosen):
+                    return
+                vector = tuple(chosen.get(name, -1) for name in names)
+                if best_vector is None or (
+                    vector > best_vector if preference == "maximum"
+                    else vector < best_vector
+                ):
+                    best_vector = vector
+                    best = dict(chosen)
+                return
+
+            # Any unresolved name is valid; this deterministic choice only affects search order.
+            name = min(pending)
+            low, high = constraints[name]
+            rows = [row for row in packages[name]
+                    if low <= row["version"] <= high
+                    and row["version"] not in blocked.get(name, [])
+                    and (name not in pins or row["version"] == pins[name])]
+            rows.sort(key=lambda row: row["version"], reverse=(preference == "maximum"))
+            for row in rows:
+                version = row["version"]
+                new_chosen = dict(chosen)
+                new_chosen[name] = version
+                new_constraints = dict(constraints)
+                new_edges = {key: list(value) for key, value in edges.items()}
+                children = []
+                valid = True
+                for dep in row.get("deps", []):
+                    feature = dep.get("feature", "")
+                    if feature and feature not in features:
+                        continue
+                    child = dep["name"]
+                    children.append(child)
+                    bounds = (dep["min"], dep["max"])
+                    if child in new_constraints:
+                        old = new_constraints[child]
+                        bounds = (max(old[0], bounds[0]), min(old[1], bounds[1]))
+                    if bounds[0] > bounds[1]:
+                        valid = False
+                        break
+                    new_constraints[child] = bounds
+                    if child in new_chosen and not (bounds[0] <= new_chosen[child] <= bounds[1]):
+                        valid = False
+                        break
+                if valid:
+                    new_edges[name] = children
+                    search(new_chosen, new_constraints, new_edges)
+
+        roots = {name: tuple(bounds) for name, bounds in data["roots"].items()}
+        search({}, roots, {})
+        return {"versions": best} if best is not None else {"error": "unsatisfiable"}
+
+    return solve
+

 def _build_component_07():
+    from itertools import combinations
+
+    def solve(data):
+        jobs = [job for job in data["jobs"]
+                if job["id"] not in data.get("blocked", [])]
+        k = data["k"]
+        mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+        quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+        best_ids = None
+        best_value = None
+
+        for chosen in combinations(jobs, k):
+            ids = tuple(sorted(job["id"] for job in chosen))
+            if not mandatory.issubset(ids):
+                continue
+            counts = {}
+            for job in chosen:
+                counts[job["group"]] = counts.get(job["group"], 0) + 1
+            if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+                   for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+                continue
+            # At each start, discard intervals that have already ended; endpoints touch safely.
+            active_ends = []
+            valid = True
+            for job in sorted(chosen, key=lambda item: (item["start"], item["end"], item["id"])):
+                active_ends = [end for end in active_ends if end > job["start"]]
+                active_ends.append(job["end"])
+                if len(active_ends) > 2:
+                    valid = False
+                    break
+            if not valid:
+                continue
+            value = sum(job["value"] for job in chosen)
+            if (best_value is None or value > best_value
+                    or (value == best_value and ids < best_ids)):
+                best_value, best_ids = value, ids
+
+        if best_ids is None:
+            return {"error": "impossible"}
+        return {"selected": list(best_ids), "value": best_value}
+
+    return solve
